description: Source code for icStringBuffer implementation, including creation, destruction, appending strings, appending with commas, and retrieving buffer contents.

classes.name: _icStringBuffer
classes.description: Internal structure representing a string buffer, containing a FIFO buffer.

methods.name: stringBufferCreate
methods.description: Creates a new string buffer with specified initial size.

methods.name: stringBufferDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a string buffer and frees associated memory.

methods.name: stringBufferAppend
methods.description: Appends a string to the buffer, copying its contents.

methods.name: stringBufferAppendLength
methods.description: Appends a specified length of a string to the buffer.

methods.name: stringBufferAppendWithComma
methods.description: Appends a string with a comma either before or after, based on flag.

methods.name: stringBufferLength
methods.description: Returns the current length of the buffer contents.

methods.name: stringBufferToString
methods.description: Returns the buffer contents as a null-terminated string; caller must free.
